publication_claim: conditional contribution of trained residual blocks with common learned interfaces

initialization.scope: explicit seeded fresh pretraining-style zero-output block reference; not the imported trained1024 actor or the fullbank stage entry state; q/k initialization does not affect frozen identity-stack function

case_selection.rule: sort audit IDs and choose indices floor(j*(n-1)/3), j=0,1,2,3; resolve/pin allIDs+stateSHA before evaluating outputs
case_selection.forbidden: fitting-state substitution, response-based selection, warm private state reuse

support.panel: fixed first panel; same exact IDs/order in both arms

backend: qualified eager model/loss; actor graph optional only after paired gate
primary: per-checkpoint endpoint query strict-rank-zero AND positive mean group reduction AND pinned mean/tail KL thresholds; report all8 cases and paired arms
stopping: fixed32 updates for every arm/case; no query-based early stop or retuning
interpretation_limits: same-seed held-out GPT checkpoints are not new-initialization evidence
common interfaces were trained with trained blocks; resetting blocks can produce feature-distribution shift
does not compare all learned shared parameters against independently trained identity-stack interfaces
does not establish online training benefit
required_before_launch: pin closed review generation/shared state and code/source
qualify paired runner query noninterference and accounting

implementation_delta.wrapper: scripts/qualify_coordinate_transfer.py prepare/run; independent one-rank case shards
implementation_delta.remaining: supply closed parent review checkpoint; prepare immutable actor/initialization/panel/source pins; obtain later execution scheduling after fitting preservation is adequate

compute_budget.notes: Both arms,4GPT+4CIFAR cases,32support updates,query0+32; excludes optional preflight, which must be counted separately. No wall-time promise before qualification.

execution_schedule: GPU execution deferred until fitting preservation is adequate; no job launched.

commands.run_shard0: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python scripts/qualify_coordinate_transfer.py run --plan NEW_PIN_DIRECTORY/plan.json --output NEW_SHARD0_RESULTS --shard 0 --shards 2
commands.run_shard1: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=5 python scripts/qualify_coordinate_transfer.py run --plan NEW_PIN_DIRECTORY/plan.json --output NEW_SHARD1_RESULTS --shard 1 --shards 2
